title: Aquarius — Fleet telemetry
description: PX4 MAVLink -> mavlink_mqtt.py -> MQTT -> Telegraf -> InfluxDB. docker/communication_plan.md

list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "aquarius", tag: "drone", predicate: (r) => r.fleet == "${fleet}", start: -30d)
list.name: drone
list.label: Drones

list.query:

schema.tagValues(bucket: "aquarius", tag: "drone", predicate: (r) => r.fleet == "${fleet}", start: -30d)
list.name: camdrone
list.label: Camera drone

panels.title: Link
panels.description: HEARTBEAT from PX4 within the last 3 s (bridge) and a message within 5 s (dashboard).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "aquarius")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "online" and r._field == "online" and r.fleet == "${fleet}" and contains(value: r.drone, set: ${drone:json}))
  |> last()
  // no message for 5 s (bridge / PX4 gone) = offline
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time) > 5000000000 then 0.0 else r._value}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "drone"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with drone: "drone " + r.drone}))
  |> group(columns: ["drone"])

panels.title: Position and flight path
panels.description: Track = time range, big dot = last position. Same GPS as QGC (Baylands world origin).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "aquarius")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position" and (r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon") and r.fleet == "${fleet}" and contains(value: r.drone, set: ${drone:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, lat: r.lat, lon: r.lon, drone: int(v: r.drone)}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "aquarius")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position" and (r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon" or r._field == "alt_rel") and r.fleet == "${fleet}" and contains(value: r.drone, set: ${drone:json}))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, lat: r.lat, lon: r.lon, alt_rel: r.alt_rel, drone: int(v: r.drone)}))
  |> group()

  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, drone: "drone " + r.drone,
       _value: if r.total > 0.0 then string(v: int(v: r.seq) + 1) + " / " + string(v: int(v: r.total)) else "-"}))
  |> group(columns: ["drone"])

from(bucket: "aquarius")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "event" and r.fleet == "${fleet}" and contains(value: r.drone, set: ${drone:json}))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Time: r._time, Drone: "drone " + r.drone, Severity: int(v: r.severity), Message: r.text}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 200)

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
